name: Premier Explosives Ltd
about: Premier Explosives Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of industrial explosives and detonators. It also undertakes operation and maintenance (O&M) services of solid propellant plants at the Sriharikota Centre of ISRO and Solid Fuel Complex at Jagdalpur under the umbrella of DRDO.[1]
keyPoints: Leadership:[1] 1st in India to manufacture Explosives and Detonating fuse with indigenous technology. 1st in the World to produce safer and greener NHN detonators on commercial scale. 1st private company to manufacture solid propellants to missile programs.
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 95.8% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 10.1 times its book value
Earnings include an other income of Rs.17.5 Cr.
